bullets.title: AVGO: JPM outlines FY27/28 AI revenue framework — $115B→$230B, $30 EPS by FY28
bullets.body: JPM's semis/HW note formalizes AVGO's AI revenue roadmap: $115B in FY27 doubling to $230B in FY28, with $30 EPS guided for FY28. Jalapeño ASIC seen as complementary to merchant GPUs (not substitutive), and AVGO appears across Google TPU, Meta MTIA, and SambaNova as a cross-cutting beneficiary in both AI compute and networking. XPU share expected to approach parity with merchant GPU over time.

bullets.title: DELL: Massive F2Q27 beat — $47B rev (+58% YoY), $95B backlog, AI server guidance raised to $74B
bullets.body: DELL crushed F2Q27 with $47B revenue vs. $44-45B guide and $7.04 EPS vs. $4.80 guide; backlog exited the quarter at $95B. AI server revenue guidance raised to $74B for FY27 (~3x YoY, up from $60B prior). JPM framing this as a strong re-grossing moment for the HW/semis complex.

bullets.title: CIEN: Strong Q3 beat + bullish FY27 framework; Wolfe adds $660 PT (Outperform)
bullets.body: CIEN reported Q3 GM of 46.4% and OPM of 22.5%, beating consensus by ~250bps. FY27 framework guides 'at least +30%' growth with 45-46% GM. Wolfe separately rates CIEN Outperform with a $660 PT (105.6% upside), citing hyperscaler AI networking capex as a key demand driver.

bullets.title: CRDO: -26.7% on optical revenue disappointment vs. buy-side expectations
bullets.body: CRDO fell 26.7% after only reiterating its $600M+ revenue guide vs. buy-side expectations of $1B+, with the optical revenue ramp disappointing. JPM flagged this as the key negative outlier in an otherwise bullish semis/HW week.

bullets.title: AAPL: Sept 9 event — base case $100 price hike on Pro; iPhone Ultra foldable ~$2,000-2,500
bullets.body: JPM's base case for AAPL's Sept 9 event is a like-for-like $100 price increase on the Pro (to $1,199). The iPhone Ultra foldable is expected at $2,000-2,500 but framed as a proof-of-concept rather than a near-term financial driver. Pricing strategy seen as key determinant of Dec-Q performance.

bullets.title: LITE, FN: Wolfe Outperform — $1,200 PT (+42%) and $775 PT (+90%) on AI optics/networking
bullets.body: Wolfe's hyperscaler procurement channel checks support bullish views on optical/networking names: LITE rated Outperform at $1,200 PT (41.6% upside) and FN at $775 PT (90.2% upside). Both cited as key beneficiaries of Meta, Google, and Microsoft AI data center build-outs focused on optics and networking.

bullets.title: CMG, DPZ, WING: UBS sees selective restaurant opportunities amid sector weakness
bullets.body: UBS flags CMG as improving with high 3s-to-4% comp expected in 4Q supporting a potential rerating into '27. DPZ viewed positively at 16.4x '27E EPS with new Detroit-style 'the Domino' pizza driving incremental traffic; US sss ~1% 3QTD. WING trades at ~13x '27 EBITDA with 3Q sss down ~4%, but easing comps and NFL promotions may catalyze improvement.

bullets.title: COST: Hedgeye moves to Short — August SSS decelerated 50bps (3rd straight month), traffic slowing
bullets.body: Hedgeye added COST to its Short list after August SSS ex-gas decelerated 50bps for the third consecutive month and traffic slowed 100bps with weakness in food and sundries. At 25x EBITDA, Hedgeye views sensitivity to negative revisions as high.

bullets.title: BILI: JPMorgan upgrades to top pick — shareholder overhang cleared, 22% game revenue growth in 2027E
bullets.body: JPMorgan makes BILI its top pick in digital entertainment after Tencent converted its ~9% stake to $200M in convertible bonds, removing the shareholder sale overhang. A new game launch cycle begins in September (Lumi Master Sept 17, Sanwang 4Q26), with game revenue expected to turn positive YoY in 4Q26 and grow 22% in 2027E. Valuation at 11x/9x 2027/28E P/E vs. 31% NP growth is flagged as attractive.

bullets.title: SIG: UBS maintains Buy ($122 PT) ahead of 2Q earnings — expects FY27 EPS guide raised 35-40c
bullets.body: UBS maintains Buy on SIG with a $122 PT, expecting a modest 2Q EPS beat and management to raise the low end of FY27 EPS guidance ($9.20-$11.00) by ~35-40c. Industry checks indicate a decent quarter; tariff pressure peaked in 1Q, gold cost pressure peaked in 2Q, and demand above $2,000 remains healthy while weakness is concentrated below $150.

bullets.title: Citi macro: Bullish US equities into year-end but September headwinds; favors QQQ, short-dated SPX calls
bullets.body: Citi is constructive on US equities driven by AI capex scaling from $1T (2026) to $3.8T by 2030 and S&P 500 12m forward EPS up 28% YTD to $397, forecasting another 12% growth in 2027. Near-term risks include hawkish Fed (62% odds of September hike), September seasonality, and election uncertainty. Recommends QQQ as the best hedge and short-dated SPX calls given 1-week implied vol at 8.8% (below 10th percentile).
